scope: One fresh portable subdivision1 reference case only; all checked variant0 complex responses and fresh geometry match accepted coarse arrays with zero numerical difference.
No native solve or fine-mesh regeneration. The internal threeQ/epsilon variants passed their unchanged original gates.
Historical complex-scalar serializer failure and exact-prefix reuse remain recorded separately; this portable verification made one freshbase/Green/Gamma case without historical staging dependencies.
Repository changes comprise only seven new scripts; existing boom_fin_reference.py and existing fixture are reused unchanged.
No pending scientific process or file writes remain; both fresh supervisor/child and saved comparison are terminal and reaped.

portable_regression.scope: One fine68-element/38-Gamma case at1Hz with nativeF3 and physical upper-tipMz, against saved independent accepted outputs; no reference regeneration and no full-aircraft/experimental claim.

limitations: Each mesh uses independently manufactured fixed aerodynamic base counterloads. This is not a common-load aircraft mesh-convergence study.

Boom aerodynamic radius is removed; boom structural properties and inertia remain. Live gravity, propulsion and aircraft free-frame coupling are excluded; original fixed spatial dead loads and preload remain.
The 1% criterion is a scaled complex relative infinity norm per output group and input, not a pointwise relative error bound.
The coarse comparison and corrected base-geometry discrepancies are descriptive only.
Portable fresh reference entry point was verified on subdivision1 only; original subdivision2 reference and fresh fine native regression both pass.
retained_failures: Original rigid-limit checker scalar/vector mismatch; retained first pair replayed saved-only after checker correction.
Original reference complex-scalar serialization failure; three complete numerical packets and base circulation reused exactly after recorder correction.
